correctness.rationale: The integral CE differential has d alpha=0 and d beta_j=-a_j alpha wedge beta_j; every subset S forms a disjoint two-term integral complex multiplied by positive w(S). This proves groups and squarezero products exactly, with no division or characteristic assumptions. Reduction kills the differential precisely at primes dividing w(S). Independently assembled differential matrices were checked for d²=0, integral Smith invariants and modular ranks for seven multisets over five primes.

originality.rationale: The exact integral CE torsion spectra and square-zero product structure for the specified primitive positive-weight form were not found in relevant published and semantic searches. Coll–Gerstenhaber 2016 already covers the modular field-coefficient corollary; this is explicitly not claimed as new. Avetisyan 2016 provides broad structural coverage but no integral cohomology; Heib 2026 supplies the motivating positive-weight classification. Full Heib body access failed, so implicit older coverage is a residual risk rather than a uniqueness claim.
residual_risks: The full text/appendices of arxiv:2610.04001 were not fully accessible in this run.
An older unindexed integral Lie-ring cohomology computation could imply the same Smith decomposition.
The general toral field cohomology formula is already known, and only the exact integral arithmetic classification is claimed as original.

value.rationale: A complete canonical integral cohomology classification for all primitive positive weight/multiplicity parameters records precise torsion exponent and all modular exceptional primes. In normalized dimension three, torsion exponents m and m+1 are arbitrarily large and coprime despite constant complex Betti profile; the invariant detects information not accessible from complex cohomology. It is an exact structural and arithmetic classification for a natural recent family, not an arbitrary isolated computation.
